title: Add minimum rank validation to admissible() method
description: The admissible() method (line 409) does not check if candidate.rank < min_hop_rank_increase, allowing RFC 6550-invalid ranks to slip through for same-version DIOs. The candidate_admissible() function has this check but is only called for newer versions. Add the check to admissible() to reject parents advertising invalid ranks.
close_reason: Fixed: Added minimum rank validation (candidate.rank < min_hop_rank_increase) to admissible() method. This ensures same-version DIOs with RFC 6550-invalid ranks (below root rank) are properly rejected, matching the validation already done in candidate_admissible() for newer versions.
